about.en: FAI is the token of Freysa, a set of AI agent products built around an autonomous agent that holds its own keys and a framework for sovereign, user-owned AI agents. FAI is an ERC-20 on Base at 0xb33ff54b9f7242ef1593d2c9bcd8f9df46c77935; it is unrelated to other tokens using the FAI ticker.
